description: The image is a line drawing titled "Diagram 20 Height of various fittings in toilet accommodation", with two elevations. The left elevation shows a mirror with a grab rail on each side of it and a washbasin below. A top horizontal dimension reads "600-700mm"; a left vertical dimension reads "1600mm min."; a right vertical dimension reads "1100mm". A label, "600mm grab rail each side of mirror", points to the right rail, and a dashed line labelled "Centre of grab rail" marks its centre. A lower vertical arrow reads "height to rim of basin A. 780-800mm B. 720-740mm". The caption reads "Height of independent washbasin and location of associated fittings, for wheelchair users and standing people; A. For people standing; B. For use from WC". The right elevation shows a rectangle labelled "Mirror" on the right, with a "Shaver point" and an "Automatic hand drier" to its left. A right vertical dimension reads "1600mm min."; left vertical dimensions read "800-1000mm" and "600mm". The caption reads "Mirror located away from washbasin suitable for seated and standing people (mirror and associated fittings used within a WC compartment or serving a range of compartments)".
